messages:
Bea (CS Ops): quick alert  noticed a batch of accounts dropped to 0 health after yesterday's enrichment run (vendor: BlackBox). looks like company_size and ARR fields became null.
Marcus (CRM): oh no. did the enrichment schema change? i saw a new optional field in the contract but not this.
Yuki (Data): pulling logs now. initial look: enrichment job returned `null` for company_size for ~860 accounts and our mapping coerces null->0 which then pushes into health calc.
Rohit (Enablement): 0 health triggers auto-escalate playbooks and renewal nudges, right? that's going to annoy customers.
Bea (CS Ops): yep, we had 120 auto-escalations and 47 renewal nudges in last 2 hours. we need a fast safeguard: stop auto-escalations for accounts where a recent enrichment run touched the record and company_size is null.
playbook-bot: created run id guard-enrich-179999  status: queued. (/playbooks/run guard-enrich-179999) :warning:
Marcus (CRM): i'll add a mapping sanitizer that maps null company_size -> 'unknown' and null ARR -> 'unknown' instead of 0. i'll push as a hotfix behind feature flag. snippet: 
Marcus (CRM): ```py
if payload.company_size is None:
    mapped.company_size = 'unknown'
else:
    mapped.company_size = payload.company_size
```
Yuki (Data): good. also suggest we add a transient rule in scoring: treat 'unknown' as no-change to previous value rather than forcing zero. reduces churn on missing enrichments.
Bea (CS Ops): can we do a lightweight hold first? sample 10% of affected accounts, pause escalation/playbooks, and tag them "enrich:hold" so CS can see them in queue.
Rohit (Enablement): yes please. i'll prepare an owner-facing one-liner explaining: "We saw a data enrichment issue; holding automated outreach while we confirm records." keeps it simple.
playbook-bot: guard-enrich-179999 moved to in-progress  action: sample_hold applied to 10% of affected accounts. :white_check_mark:
Yuki (Data): running quick audit: of the 860 accounts, 72% were vendor nulls, 28% legitimate small companies with empty company_size. saving CSV to /shared/cs/enrich-audit-179999.csv
Marcus (CRM): deploying sanitizer to staging now. will also add a regression test that rejects null->0 coercion in mapping layer.
Bea (CS Ops): after sanitizer and scoring fallback, we'll lift holds. for now keep the admin toggle exposed for CS leads: admin.playbooks.hold_run=guard-enrich-179999.
playbook-bot: admin flag registered for run guard-enrich-179999.
Rohit (Enablement): i'll post the outreach copy in 15m. also requesting CS to log outcomes in the triage ticket so we can tweak scoring for unknown sizes.
Yuki (Data): follow-up: adding metric "enrich_null_rate" to dashboard with alert >5% in 24h. will also run backfill detection to see if any historical hits need fixing.
Bea (CS Ops): thanks team. next steps: Marcus pushes mapping fix to prod behind flag, Yuki monitors audit and dashboard, Rohit preps outreach template, and i'll coordinate CS triage tomorrow 10am PT. tagging @channel for visibility and closing loop here once triage completes.
